home.title: Thai Akha Kitchen | Authentic Cooking Class in Chiang Mai
home.description: Cook 11 authentic Akha highland dishes at your personal station. Tailored to dietary needs, from hotel pick-up to full-color cookbook.

cookingClass.title: Cooking Classes | Thai Akha Kitchen
cookingClass.description: Learn authentic Akha highland cooking in Chiang Mai. Morning and evening classes available with hotel pickup included.

morning.title: Morning Cooking Class & Market Tour | Thai Akha Kitchen
morning.description: 6-hour morning cooking class in Chiang Mai (1,400 THB). 1-hour market tour with bamboo baskets, then cook 11 dishes at your own wok. Vegan/allergy safe.

evening.title: Evening Cooking Class in Chiang Mai | Thai Akha Kitchen
evening.description: Relaxed 5-hour evening cooking class in Chiang Mai (1,300 THB). 5:00 to 9:00 PM. Cook and eat 11 dishes for dinner at your own wok. Free hotel pickup.
